summary.zh: 信纸真的在 3D 里折三折（背面写着收件人），掉进航空信封，封盖合上，火漆印砸下来，整封信先往下蓄力再“嗖”地飞走。做“发送成功”反馈很合适。
summary.en: The letter folds in thirds in real 3D (the back shows the addressee), drops into an airmail envelope, the flap closes, a wax seal slams on, and the whole thing winds up and whooshes away. A lovely “sent” confirmation.

technique.zh: 信纸是三块面板，上下两块各有正反面（backface-visibility: hidden），分别绕自己的边 rotateX(±180°)，再 translateZ 几像素避免和中间那块抢层级。坑：给 preserve-3d 的元素做 opacity 动画会把 3D 拍扁，所以淡入放在外层。信封封盖用 scaleY(−1→1)，翻过中线时换 z-index。
technique.en: Three panels; top and bottom have front and back faces (backface-visibility: hidden) and rotateX(±180°) about their own edge, with a few px of translateZ so they do not fight the middle panel. Gotcha: animating opacity on a preserve-3d element flattens it, so the fade lives on a wrapper. The flap uses scaleY(−1→1) and swaps z-index as it passes the middle.

desc.zh: 航空条纹 / 火漆颜色

adapt.zh: 在提交成功的回调里调一次 play() 就行；信纸正面是普通 HTML（#sheetTpl），换成你的表单摘要会很有意思。
adapt.en: Call play() from your submit-success callback; the letter face is plain HTML (#sheetTpl), so drop in a summary of what was sent.
